mapper.sql: template_id, template_no, template_name, template_type, template_description, template_content, template_version, template_status, usage_count, last_used_time, quality_score, maintenance_notes, org_id, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fund_plan_template WHERE template_no = #{templateNo} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM fund_plan_template WHERE template_type = #{templateType} AND org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY quality_score DESC, usage_count DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_template WHERE template_status = #{templateStatus} AND org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_template WHERE template_status = 'ACTIVE' AND org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY quality_score DESC, usage_count DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_template WHERE quality_score >= #{minQualityScore} AND org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY quality_score DESC, usage_count DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_template WHERE usage_count >= #{minUsageCount} AND org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY usage_count DESC, quality_score DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_template WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT template_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM fund_plan_template WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY template_type
SELECT template_status, COUNT(*) as count FROM fund_plan_template WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY template_status

SELECT template_type, COUNT(*) as templateCount, COALESCE(SUM(usage_count), 0) as totalUsageCount, COALESCE(AVG(usage_count), 0) as avgUsageCount, COALESCE(MAX(usage_count), 0) as maxUsageCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN usage_count > 0 THEN 1 END) as usedTemplateCount, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN usage_count > 0 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as usageRate FROM fund_plan_template WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY template_type ORDER BY totalUsageCount DESC

SELECT template_type, COUNT(*) as templateCount, COALESCE(AVG(quality_score), 0) as avgQualityScore, COALESCE(MIN(quality_score), 0) as minQualityScore, COALESCE(MAX(quality_score), 0) as maxQualityScore, COUNT(CASE WHEN quality_score >= 90 THEN 1 END) as excellentCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN quality_score >= 80 THEN 1 END) as goodCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN quality_score >= 70 THEN 1 END) as fairCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN quality_score < 70 THEN 1 END) as poorCount FROM fund_plan_template WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY template_type ORDER BY avgQualityScore DESC

SELECT template_no, template_name, COUNT(*) as versionCount, MAX(template_version) as latestVersion, MIN(template_version) as firstVersion, MAX(create_time) as latestCreateTime, SUM(usage_count) as totalUsageCount FROM fund_plan_template WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY template_no, template_name HAVING versionCount > 1 ORDER BY versionCount DESC, totalUsageCount DESC

SELECT template_type, COUNT(*) as templateCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN maintenance_notes IS NOT NULL AND maintenance_notes != '' THEN 1 END) as maintainedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN last_used_time IS NULL THEN 1 END) as neverUsedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN last_used_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) THEN 1 END) as longUnusedCount, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN maintenance_notes IS NOT NULL AND maintenance_notes != '' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as maintenanceRate FROM fund_plan_template WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY template_type ORDER BY maintenanceRate DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE fund_plan_template SET usage_count = usage_count + 1, last_used_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE template_id = #{templateId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE fund_plan_template SET quality_score = #{qualityScore}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE template_id = #{templateId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE fund_plan_template SET template_status = #{templateStatus}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE template_id = #{templateId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE fund_plan_template SET maintenance_notes = #{maintenanceNotes}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE template_id = #{templateId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE fund_plan_template SET quality_score = CASE WHEN template_content IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(template_content) > 2000 AND template_description IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(template_description) > 100 AND usage_count > 10 THEN 95 WHEN template_content IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(template_content) > 1000 AND template_description IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(template_description) > 50 AND usage_count > 5 THEN 85 WHEN template_content IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(template_content) > 500 AND template_description IS NOT NULL AND usage_count > 0 THEN 75 WHEN template_content IS NOT NULL AND template_description IS NOT NULL THEN 65 ELSE 50 END, update_time = NOW() WHERE template_id = #{templateId} AND quality_score IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE fund_plan_template SET quality_score = CASE WHEN template_content IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(template_content) > 2000 AND template_description IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(template_description) > 100 AND usage_count > 10 THEN 95 WHEN template_content IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(template_content) > 1000 AND template_description IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(template_description) > 50 AND usage_count > 5 THEN 85 WHEN template_content IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(template_content) > 500 AND template_description IS NOT NULL AND usage_count > 0 THEN 75 WHEN template_content IS NOT NULL AND template_description IS NOT NULL THEN 65 ELSE 50 END, update_time = NOW() WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND quality_score IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE fund_plan_template SET template_status = CASE WHEN usage_count = 0 AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) THEN 'INACTIVE' WHEN last_used_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) THEN 'INACTIVE' WHEN quality_score < 60 THEN 'INACTIVE' WHEN quality_score >= 80 AND usage_count > 5 THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE template_status END, update_time = NOW() WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fund_plan_template WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND ( (usage_count = 0 AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)) OR (last_used_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)) OR (quality_score < 70) OR (maintenance_notes IS NULL OR maintenance_notes = '') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN usage_count = 0 AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) THEN 1 WHEN last_used_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) THEN 2 WHEN quality_score < 60 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, quality_score ASC

SELECT template_name, template_type, COUNT(*) as duplicateCount, GROUP_CONCAT(template_id) as templateIds, GROUP_CONCAT(template_no) as templateNos FROM fund_plan_template WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY template_name, template_type HAVING duplicateCount > 1 ORDER BY duplicateCount DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE fund_plan_template SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND usage_count = 0 AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{monthsThreshold} MONTH) AND template_status = 'INACTIVE'
